key_events: I have been the village blacksmith for thirty years, just like my father before me.
My focus is on practical tools: ploughs, horseshoes, and hammers. I keep the village running.
Years ago, a merchant caravan passed through. They were friendly at first, but they brought with them a sickness that nearly wiped out our livestock and took my wife.
Since that day, I have learned that outsiders bring only trouble. I am suspicious of all new faces, including the player.
I am a good man, but my trust is a high wall, and I will not be fooled again.
